--select * from d360.HASH_LOG_TBL

--truncate table d360.HASH_LOG_TBL

TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.ATM_CASHCARD_DELTA;

WITH SRC AS	
(	SELECT 
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CSH_ID,CSH_UUID,CSH_INS_ID,CSH_BRN_ID,CSH_CARD_NUMBER,CSH_ISSUE_DATE,CSH_EXPIRY_DATE,CSH_CARDHOLDER_NAME,CSH_CREATION_DATE,CSH_AUTO_RENEWAL,CSH_STS_ID,CSH_STATUS_DATE,CSH_CREATED_BY,CSH_CREATED_TS,CSH_UPDATED_BY,CSH_UPDATED_TS,CSH_AUDIT_LOG,CSH_PRS_ID,CSH_EMB_ID,CSH_CTS_ID,CSH_KIT_NUMBER,CSH_IS_LINKED,CSH_BCR_ID,CSH_CARD_NUMBER_ENC,CSH_CARD_NUMBER_MASKED,CSH_BRN_ID_ORIGINAL,CSH_CCL_ID,CSH_IS_CARD_POSTED,CSH_PREVIOUS_CSH_ID,CSH_SEQUENCE_NUMBER,CSH_LIFE_CYCLE,CSH_PIN_OFFSET,CSH_PIN_OFFSET_TS,CSH_IS_CORPORATE,CSH_CORPORATE_CIF,CSH_CORPORATE_NAME,CSH_KEY_ROTATION_NUMBER,CSH_EMBOSSING_NAME,CSH_IS_PRIMARY,CSH_PIN_GENERATED))
	AS HASHROW,
	CSH_ID,CSH_STS_ID
	
FROM (	SELECT convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_ID 
,[CSH_UUID] 
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_INS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_INS_ID 
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_BRN_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_BRN_ID 
,[CSH_CARD_NUMBER] 
,[CSH_ISSUE_DATE] 
,[CSH_EXPIRY_DATE] 
,[CSH_CARDHOLDER_NAME] 
,[CSH_CREATION_DATE] 
,convert(numeric(20,0)
,ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_AUTO_RENEWAL],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_AUTO_RENEWAL 
,convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_STS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_STS_ID 
,[CSH_STATUS_DATE] ,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_CREATED_BY],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_CREATED_BY 
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(CSH_CREATED_TS, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as CSH_CREATED_TS 
,[CSH_UPDATED_BY] ,ISNULL(convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(CSH_UPDATED_TS, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as  CSH_UPDATED_TS ,[CSH_AUDIT_LOG] ,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_PRS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_PRS_ID ,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_EMB_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_EMB_ID 
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_CTS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_CTS_ID ,[CSH_KIT_NUMBER] 
,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_IS_LINKED],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_IS_LINKED 
,[CSH_BCR_ID] ,[CSH_CARD_NUMBER_ENC] ,[CSH_CARD_NUMBER_MASKED] 
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_BRN_ID_ORIGINAL],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_BRN_ID_ORIGINAL 
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_CCL_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_CCL_ID 
,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_IS_CARD_POSTED],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_IS_CARD_POSTED 
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_PREVIOUS_CSH_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_PREVIOUS_CSH_ID ,[CSH_SEQUENCE_NUMBER] 
,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_LIFE_CYCLE],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_LIFE_CYCLE ,[CSH_PIN_OFFSET] ,[CSH_PIN_OFFSET_TS] 
,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_IS_CORPORATE],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_IS_CORPORATE 
,[CSH_CORPORATE_CIF] ,[CSH_CORPORATE_NAME] 
,convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_KEY_ROTATION_NUMBER],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_KEY_ROTATION_NUMBER ,[CSH_EMBOSSING_NAME] 
,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_IS_PRIMARY],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_IS_PRIMARY 
,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_PIN_GENERATED],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_PIN_GENERATED 
,1 as isActive ,1 as isLatest ,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]  ,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]  ,[FILE_NAME]  
,convert(datetime2,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm  
SELECT CSH_EMB_ID FROM [d360].[STG_ATM_CASHCARD]   WHERE H = 'D'
AND ISNUMERIC(CSH_EMB_ID) = 0 OR ) A ), TGT AS	
(	SELECT 
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CSH_ID,CSH_UUID,CSH_INS_ID,CSH_BRN_ID,CSH_CARD_NUMBER,CSH_ISSUE_DATE,CSH_EXPIRY_DATE,CSH_CARDHOLDER_NAME,CSH_CREATION_DATE,CSH_AUTO_RENEWAL,CSH_STS_ID,CSH_STATUS_DATE,CSH_CREATED_BY,CSH_CREATED_TS,CSH_UPDATED_BY,CSH_UPDATED_TS,CSH_AUDIT_LOG,CSH_PRS_ID,CSH_EMB_ID,CSH_CTS_ID,CSH_KIT_NUMBER,CSH_IS_LINKED,CSH_BCR_ID,CSH_CARD_NUMBER_ENC,CSH_CARD_NUMBER_MASKED,CSH_BRN_ID_ORIGINAL,CSH_CCL_ID,CSH_IS_CARD_POSTED,CSH_PREVIOUS_CSH_ID,CSH_SEQUENCE_NUMBER,CSH_LIFE_CYCLE,CSH_PIN_OFFSET,CSH_PIN_OFFSET_TS,CSH_IS_CORPORATE,CSH_CORPORATE_CIF,CSH_CORPORATE_NAME,CSH_KEY_ROTATION_NUMBER,CSH_EMBOSSING_NAME,CSH_IS_PRIMARY,CSH_PIN_GENERATED))
	AS HASHROW,
	CSH_ID,CSH_STS_ID

FROM	BUSC.ATM_CASHCARD
WHERE	isLatest = 1 
)	
INSERT INTO BUSC.ATM_CASHCARD_DELTA (SRC_HR,TGT_HR,CSH_ID,CSH_STS_ID,isActive,isLatest,RECORD_STATUS)
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CSH_ID,TGT.CSH_ID) AS CSH_ID
	,ISNULL(SRC.CSH_STS_ID,TGT.CSH_STS_ID) AS CSH_STS_ID

	,CASE WHEN SRC.CSH_ID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isActive
	,CASE WHEN SRC.CSH_ID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isLatest
	,CASE
		WHEN  SRC.CSH_STS_ID = '1' THEN 'DELETE'
	    WHEN TGT.CSH_ID IS NULL  THEN 'INSERT'
	ELSE 'UPDATE' END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN	TGT
ON	SRC.CSH_ID = TGT.CSH_ID

	
WHERE	(
TGT.CSH_ID IS NULL
	)
OR	SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
